newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kronos '97 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kronos '97 estimate cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist cut is 1997 estimate for Kronos Inc to $1.32 a share from $1.42 a share, but left the revenue estimate unchanged at $170 million.
-- The move follows Kronos' second quarter earnings of $0.21 a share versus $0.28 one year ago.
-- Hambrecht said Kronos' quarterly revenues were slighly off, but that was exacerbated by high research and development as well as sales, general and administrative costs.
-- Company management also indicated a few of its high margin client server versions of a successful product, called TKC, were delayed, Hambrecht said in a statement.
